apps.name: SideInstaller
apps.subtitle: An an app that installs Sidestore on iOS 27, fully on-device
apps.localizedDescription: Install SideStore and LiveContainer directly on your iPhone. No PC required.
apps.versionDescription:
### Added
- **Pick the developer team that signs.** An Apple Account on more than one developer team (a paid Apple Developer Program membership or a company's team, besides the free one every account has) is asked once which team signs, each marked Free or Paid. The question starts on the team that signed SideInstaller itself, so a copy siboot installed with another team now refreshes itself in place. The pick is remembered for the Apple ID and used for installs, refreshes, Certificates and Entitlements; swipe the Apple ID in Settings › Account and tap Team to pick again.

apps.name: Nightflix
apps.subtitle: An iOS movie and series streaming app
apps.versionDescription:
Nightflix 3.0 is a complete redesign.

- New Netflix-style interface: Home with Series / Films / Categories filters, a featured title, Top 10 rows, Continue Watching and "Because You Watched" rows
- New & Hot tab: Coming Soon with release reminders, Everyone's Watching, and today's Top 10 series and films
- My Nightflix tab: Continue Watching, My List, titles you've rated, reminders and recently watched
- Tap a title for a quick preview, or open its full page with episodes, More Like This and trailers
- Search also finds titles by actor
- New built-in player (VidFast) with resume and episode autoplay
- The player opens in landscape and plays sound even with the silent switch on
